items.exampleEn: Climbing the mountain in this storm would be extremely hazardous.
items.exampleZh: 在這場暴風雨中爬山會極度危險。

items.exampleEn: Kids seem to have endless energy, even after running around all afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們好像有用不完的精力，跑了一整個下午還是不累。

items.exampleEn: Some butterflies make a long migration across the country every year.
items.exampleZh: 有些蝴蝶每年都會長途遷徙，橫越整個國家。

items.exampleEn: You can smell the exhaust when you stand behind a bus.
items.exampleZh: 站在公車後面就聞得到廢氣。

items.exampleEn: The cat looked around carefully at its new surroundings.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓小心地環顧牠的新環境。

items.exampleEn: Wash your hands so you don't contaminate the food you are cooking.
items.exampleZh: 記得洗手，才不會汙染你正在煮的食物。

items.exampleEn: In the old story, the clever fox saves the village from starvation.
items.exampleZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，聰明的狐狸讓村子免於飢荒。

items.exampleEn: The fumes from the fresh paint made the room smell strong.
items.exampleZh: 剛刷的油漆散發的氣味讓房間味道很重。

items.exampleEn: Farmers here grow rice in an ecologically friendly way, using ducks to eat insects.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的農民以生態友善的方式種稻，靠鴨子來吃蟲。

items.sentenceEn: Car exhaust is one of the main causes of dirty air in cities.
items.sentenceZh: 汽車廢氣是城市空氣髒的主要原因之一。

items.audioEn: Please don't throw paint cans in the trash; they are hazardous and need special collection.
items.audioZh: 請不要把油漆罐丟進垃圾桶，那是有害物品，需要特別回收。
items.questionZh: 油漆罐為什麼不能丟進垃圾桶？
options: They are too heavy to carry

items.sentenceEn: Solar and wind energy are becoming cheaper every year.
items.sentenceZh: 太陽能和風能每年都變得更便宜。

items.sentenceEn: Factories must not let dirty water contaminate the river.
items.sentenceZh: 工廠不得讓廢水汙染河流。

items.stemEn: Scientists follow the ____ of whales from cold seas to warm waters each year.
items.stemZh: 科學家追蹤鯨魚每年從寒冷海域到溫暖海域的遷徙。

items.stemEn: Building a dam here would be ____ harmful to the river.
items.stemZh: 在這裡蓋水壩，在生態上會對河流造成傷害。

items.passageEn: Our school recently studied a wetland near the city. It is ecologically rich, and it is an important stop during the spring migration of many birds. However, the wetland faces several problems. Traffic exhaust and fumes from a nearby factory pollute the air, and some hazardous waste has been found near the water. Our teacher explained that if the water is contaminated, fish die and birds lose their food, which can lead to starvation. The good news is that volunteers now clean up the wetland and its surroundings every month, and the city plans to use more clean energy in the area.
items.passageZh: 我們學校最近研究了城市附近的一片濕地。那裡生態豐富，是許多鳥類春季遷徙時的重要中繼站。不過，這片濕地面臨幾個問題。交通廢氣和附近工廠排放的氣體汙染了空氣，水邊也發現了一些有害廢棄物。老師說明，如果水受到汙染，魚會死掉，鳥類就會失去食物，可能因此挨餓。好消息是，現在志工每個月都會清理濕地及周遭環境，市政府也計畫在這一帶使用更多乾淨能源。

questions.questionZh: 這片濕地對鳥類有什麼重要性？
options: 是牠們築巢的高山地區

items.promptZh: 這輛舊卡車排出很多黑色廢氣。
referenceEn: This old truck produces a lot of black exhaust.
A lot of black exhaust comes out of this old truck.
rubricZh: exhaust 指廢氣，是不可數名詞（例如 a lot of exhaust 等）

items.promptZh: 這棟新大樓用的能源只有舊大樓的一半。
referenceEn: This new building uses half as much energy as the old one.
The new building uses only half the energy of the old building.
rubricZh: energy 指能源，不可數（例如 half as much energy、half the energy 等）
「只有…的一半」可寫，例如 half as much… as、half the… of、50% less… than 等
